description: The transcript of an audio block: timed segments with word timings, the speakers, the engine that produced it, and detected sounds.

main.description: The transcript of an audio block: timed segments with word timings, the speakers, the engine that produced it, and detected sounds. The record key is the key of the entry that holds the audio and the audio block's id joined by a colon (<entry>:<block>), so each recording has at most one transcript and an entry with several recordings has one per recording. The full text is the segments' text joined in time order. A transcript too large for one sealed record, such as one for a recording many hours long, isn't written: the device shows a RecordTooLarge sync error and keeps the transcript locally, rather than trimming or splitting it.

entry.description: The entry that holds the audio.

blockId.description: The audio block's id within the entry.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag requested or detected for the transcript, such as en-US.

segments.description: The transcript's segments, ordered by start time and then by id.

speakers.description: The speakers that segments and words refer to.

revision.description: Increases every time the transcript changes. When two devices hold different versions, the higher revision is newer.

status.description: Where the transcript is in its life. pending: requested but not started, with no segments yet. inProgress: the first recognition pass is still producing segments. refining: a more accurate second pass is improving a transcript that already exists. complete: every segment is stable. failed: recognition stopped with an error.

createdAt.description: When the transcript was first produced, when known.

id.description: Identifier of the segment, unique within the transcript. A later, better recognition pass replaces the segment with the same id.

startMs.description: Start of the segment, in milliseconds from the beginning of the recording.

endMs.description: End of the segment, in milliseconds from the beginning of the recording. Never before startMs.

words.description: Word-level timings, used to highlight search results and to jump to a word during playback.

speaker.description: The id of the speaker in the transcript's speakers list.

confidence.description: Recognition confidence, in thousandths: the 0 to 1 value times 1000, rounded to the nearest whole number with halves away from zero and kept between 0 and 1000. Left out when the value is NaN or infinite.

source.description: Which recognition pass produced the segment, from least to most authoritative: text imported from older storage, live recognition on the device, live recognition in LogDate Cloud, a second pass on the device, and a second pass in LogDate Cloud. A segment is only replaced by one from an equal or more authoritative pass.

final.description: True when the segment is stable and won't change again.

word.description: One recognized word and when it was spoken.

normalizedText.description: The word in the form search matches against, such as lowercase without punctuation.

confidence.description: Recognition confidence, in thousandths: the 0 to 1 value times 1000, rounded to the nearest whole number with halves away from zero and kept between 0 and 1000. Left out when the value is NaN or infinite.

speaker.description: The id of the speaker in the transcript's speakers list.
Someone who speaks in the recording.

id.description: Identifier that segments and words use to refer to this speaker.

label.description: The name shown for the speaker, such as Speaker 1.

engine.description: The speech recognizer that produced the transcript.

modelId.description: The speech model the recognizer used.

soundTag.description: A non-speech sound detected in the recording, such as laughter or rain.

confidence.description: Detection confidence, in thousandths: the 0 to 1 value times 1000, rounded to the nearest whole number with halves away from zero and kept between 0 and 1000. Left out when the value is NaN or infinite.
